disagreement.summary: Two experts put the chance below the panel mean; their notes are about access and conflict.
One expert puts the chance above the panel mean; the subject of their note is not summarised here, because in a panel of eight it would name them.

number_note: 3 estimates were exact percentages and 3 were one of the five words; for those the mean uses the band midpoint, which is an assumption.
reidentification_note: In a panel of eight a distinctive reason may identify its author to colleagues; experts were told this before answering.
